`h: [3` opens a bracket it never closes. The stopgap reads the raw text `[3`, which is no score, so its h is null and gantry.attention reports bad_h. devagent's parser stores the value as `3` and reports meta_unreadable, which the reader shows as devagent wrote it. Once #12 switches, this leaf scores 3 and gets no bad_h.

why: `issue: [Issue-9]` is a list. The stopgap treats it as no issue: id and reports no_issue. devagent sets the node's issue to null and reports issue_malformed, not leaf_no_issue, so nothing maps onto no_issue; the reader shows issue_malformed as devagent wrote it.
